children: According to Sina Finance, Amazon is nearing a $7.5 billion deal to acquire AI startup Decart. The talks are at an advanced stage, and the deal could be finalized as early as the beginning of next week, though negotiations could still fall apart. Decart’s core software product improves the efficiency of AI model operations and frees up chip computing capacity. The potential acquisition would help Amazon Web Services compete with Nvidia.

title: Amazon Nears $7.5 Billion Deal to Acquire AI Startup Decart
